record.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.20224. Abstract summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) has demonstrated exceptional capabilities in synthesizing novel views of 3D scenes. However, its training is heavily reliant on high-quality images and precise camera poses. Meeting these criteria can be challenging in non-ideal real-world conditions, where motion-blurred images frequently occur due Out of scope: Event-stream Gaussian splatting for vision.
record.title: Evagaussians: Event Stream Assisted Gaussian Splatting from Blurry Images
